prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the two silicone container from workbench.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A white lab bench with an aluminium extrusion frame runs diagonally across the foreground, carrying two white plastic wash bottles. The left bottle lies on its side, tilted along the rail, with a green band around its neck and a red/orange angled spout cap fitted. The right bottle stands upright, with a blue band around its body and a red/orange spout cap fitted. Metal locating pins, screws and two printed square fiducial (AprilTag-style) markers are mounted on the frame surface; a pale disc and a grey cylinder sit near the right marker. Behind, a black weighted base with two vertical black posts stands on a grey floor beside a white wall, LED strip lighting, and further aluminium profiles.
observations: The workbench holds two white plastic wash bottles (one on its side, one upright), not silicone containers; no silicone containers are visible on the bench.
